component.name: FITS Metadata Viewer
component.summary: Scan and inspect FITS astrophotography file metadata

description.p: A desktop application for scanning directories of FITS files and inspecting their metadata. Designed for astrophotographers who want to review their imaging sessions without leaving the desktop.

ul.li: Recursive directory scanning for .fit and .fits files
FITS header metadata extraction — no Python required
Target grouping with total integration time aggregation
Calibration frame summaries grouped by type and settings
Imaging calendar with moon phase and historical weather data
Catalog breakdown by Messier, NGC, IC, Sharpless, and more
File organiser tools for Siril preparation and cleanup
